claim: Marking a missed block produces a revised plan and risk receipt.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; click a sample block and assert a new receipt and revised blocks

claim: Imports timed events from an ICS calendar as unavailable time.
sandbox: fresh browser context; upload the shipped two-event fixture and assert both events are accepted

claim: Exports the local plan as a JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh browser context; download the backup and parse its required arrays

claim: Imports a JSON backup into the local plan.
sandbox: fresh browser context; export a plan, import that JSON file, and assert its assignment is restored

claim: Demo sample data stays in memory and is not saved into a real plan.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open demo, reset and reschedule it, inspect IndexedDB, then start for real and assert the real plan is empty

claim: Planning data stays on this site and uses no analytics, third-party fonts, or runtime content CDNs.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every request during the complete demo reset and reschedule flow and assert every request is same-origin

claim: The complete rescheduler is free for four active tasks.
sandbox: fresh browser context; add four tasks, assert all plan, then assert the fifth is declined with the stated limit

claim: Unlimited active tasks and receipt history cost $9 once through Sociobot checkout.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the exact price and checkout URL, mock a valid verifier response, and assert a second demo miss appears in Past receipts

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker control, set the context offline, reload, and assert the planner and offline state

claim: Estimates change only when the student chooses a trim.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert a missed block leaves a sample estimate unchanged, then choose Trim 30 min and assert that estimate changes by 30 minutes

claim: Rough estimates stay marked in a receipt for review.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert a sample rough estimate and its receipt review label are visible

claim: Real plans are stored in this browser’s IndexedDB database.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /planner; add a task, reload, and inspect IndexedDB for deadline-reality-check:real

claim: License checks send the stored token to the Sociobot billing API.
sandbox: fresh browser context; accept a license URL, record the mocked verifier request, and assert its Sociobot origin, GET method, query token, and empty request body

claim: Sociobot and Dodo are the merchant of record; their checkout handles payment and refunds.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the published terms name the merchant and refund handling, and assert the Buy link starts at Sociobot checkout
